ComponentDescription: Listens on an AWS IoT Core topic for SD-WAN path-control commands (fiber / 5g / auto) and applies them to the gateway's local path-selection API at http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/path. Publishes the result back to a result topic. Long-running: stays subscribed for the lifetime of the device.

com.rdk.pathcontrol:mqttproxy:1.policyDescription: Allow the path-control component to receive commands and publish results over IoT Core via Nucleus.
